$Comment: The third step of the story, Tomas the Miller's: bake a Gingerbread Cookie at the game's Chef's Stove
(Bench_Cooking) and bring it in. The recipe page, a Dough and some Spices came with the step before
(Reindeer_Food.json), so the first batch needs nothing bought. The _Christmas folder makes the id
christmas_gingerbread_cookies. Npc binds it to Tomas by the id his placement keeps in both seasons
his Christmas conversation once it is collected. A TURN_IN step is handed in where it is, so no
report-back step is added. Finishing it opens the Cookie Job on the Christmas Board.
It pays through Christmas_Chain_Pay, with favor on Santa's Nice List and Festival Favor on its own
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Crafting XP for the baking, waiting to be collected with the rest.
The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod,
unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Gingerbread_Cookies
